title: The universal clock in / out is available to any active staff member, whatever their role
preconds: 1. Three active users: an Administrator, a Service Advisor and a Time Clock User.
steps:
1. Log in as the Administrator, find the universal clock in / out control, clock in, clock out.
  2. Log in as the Service Advisor and clock in / out.
  3. Log in as the Time Clock User and clock in / out.
  4. Check that all three entries appear in the timesheet records.
expected:
Every user, including the Administrator, can clock in and out with the universal control.

All three actions are recorded in timesheets with the correct user, role and time.

Universal clock in is not gated by role.
